body:
## Maintainer request

> I know this throws a wrench into our release plan, but I've decided to change the name from "rasteratops" to "pixelelated." as I've created a cast of characters beyond rasteratops: blitterbot, VectorKnight, ditheroo, shadowmasker, I'd like "Rasteratops" to be our Mario. I already own pixelelated.com, and will change the name of the the GitHub org. to pixelelated and my name in GitHub to 8bitkid (a gaming handle I use). nothing needs to change with blitterbot in terms of that being our developer account. I will want to make the name change for our next RC.

> I think I want it all lowercase: "pixelelated". as a standard. we should change the default now as well.

> I made the changes to GitHub already. my username is now "rasteratops" and our org. is now "pixelelated", so we should make any necessary updates.

The final message supersedes the proposed personal handle 8bitkid. GitHub GET readback confirms pixelelated/distribution, personal account rasteratops ID335803305 and unchanged blitterbot ID335883270.

> hte existing folders can be renamed

> no systems are using `/Rasteratops` yet, so we can make any changes necessary so the only flow that matters is ROCKNIX > pixelelated

> we can also use Tiny5 Duo LCD for the splash font, and just that for now. it suits "pixelelated" well.

## Current state and order

## Frozen pixelelated inputs — 2026-10-04

Ocean Bands is integrated into the actual splash renderer, ES and theme. Distribution **b137d8c37323abbf07788af8bf8dbd495a31e9c9** (feature c12c0e1b30), ES **c75aa3fac967ba532fd9ba1c21fa10ca024e8bc1**, splash **8c71126ceef702528c87a4c49625e64988609f26**, and RAOfflineProxy **ec60fdd0f6522790d9d1d4d20add397bbc4da945** are published and pinned. Native Ocean output matches the canonical composition pixel for pixel; all rotations, exact colors/gaps, actual ES NanoSVG parsing and package/identity checks pass. Source receipts: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-04-pixelelated-ocean/`.

A separate clean `/workspace/repos/rocknix.worktrees/m7-pixelelated` checkout on `build/m7-pixelelated` is frozen at b137d8c373. Run owner `/workspace/tmp/pixelelated-m7-cold-01` holds the immutable launcher and input manifest (SHA256 c83828fa6013666811b044fb0842b3f493a6237366206a26bea3c645d041ca79): 6,547 regular source files, 180 symlinks and 1,608 recipes. The pinned pixelelated container is pulled; global24/WebKit4. No warm build root was copied.

**No build is running and no pixelelated image exists.** Preflight still finds approximately8GiB swap full despite44GiB available RAM. Interactive sudo is required to recycle `/swap.img`; the owner action is pending. No memory setting was changed. Next: clear that host blocker, pass preflight, run the frozen launcher through the shared5s/5min watcher, then retain and qualify the exact image. A real host/container watcher probe completed with rc0 at03:04:34UTC and its completion was reported. Active-session supervision is available; disconnected delivery remains unresolved in #395.

The final source preflight refresh adds four upstream proxy commits; packaged Python changes only the alpha2 version string. All15 patches apply with zero fuzz,199 upstream and8 fork tests pass; coupled submodules are unchanged. Complete package freshness exits0. D-WORKFLOW-147 records the already-qualified SPIR-V parent coupling; receipts: `docs/qa-logs/2026-10-04-proxy-preflight/`. These source checks do not replace candidate VM evidence or the remaining ordinary RA account fixture.


M7.P3 owns this change before the next input freeze/build and P4 fixes audit. Replacement02 remains the qualified historical RASTERATOPS engineering artifact; its successful tests do not qualify changed pixelelated bytes. Preserve closed issues, old receipts, immutable bundles and frozen build roots.

Use lowercase pixelelated for project/display/OS/image identity and /pixelelated for new cloud setups. Rasteratops is a character and the owner's GitHub handle; Blitterbot remains the developer account. Preserve persisted ROCKNIX interfaces and cloud selections. The owner confirms no fielded /Rasteratops systems: only ROCKNIX → pixelelated is a required upgrade gate. Existing folders may move through the established verified migration. Inventory distribution, ES, splash/theme, Git remotes, source URLs, registry, workflows, licence/trademark text, live tracker and release tooling.

## Can this be done on the VM?

Yes. Isolated source/host checks and GENERIC_X64 clean-install plus retained ROCKNIX RC2 upgrade guests prove the software transition. This issue authorizes no personal-cloud mutation or handheld action. Publication keeps its existing gate.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Record the new identity hierarchy and lowercase default in the append-only decision register; reconcile active naming policy, instructions, milestone order and open issue criteria. Retain historical attribution and closed titles.
- [x] Classify old-name references across active source, tools, sibling repos and infrastructure; retain an explicit compatibility/history/owner/character allowlist. Canonical org URLs and relevant Git remotes resolve to pixelelated; the personal account is verified as rasteratops and the bot identity is unchanged. Historical maxengel-owned forks retain their verified locations; rasteratops/rocknix.org returned 404 and no transfer is assumed.
- [x] Distribution/ES/splash/theme and licence/trademark source use the agreed lowercase identity and Tiny5 Duo LCD wordmark alone. Exact source pins and existing lint/syntax/identity guards pass; obsolete brand references are classified rather than globally replaced.
- [ ] New setup defaults to /pixelelated; configured /ROCKNIX and /GAMES selections and archive discovery remain usable. Isolated controls and candidate clean/upgrade receipts demonstrate no silent cloud relocation or archive loss.
- [ ] The update asset naming/procedure satisfies the ROCKNIX RC2 predecessor init check, and the new image accepts future pixelelated updates. Retain actual upgrade evidence for ROCKNIX RC2.
- [ ] Verify the build-container namespace/digest and source fetches. A monitored build with tested delivery produces a newly frozen pixelelated artifact; retain the image identity/manual-update/brand/licence/source/localisation checks and affected default/upgrade/visual/performance evidence. Do not rename or relabel replacement02.
- [ ] Expand the approved P4 primary plus Fable5.1 Facilitator fixes review to this transition; resolve findings and renew affected artifact proofs before calling the image an RC.

## Earlier monochrome source implementation — 2026-10-04

ES4d0c7a6867045245b23cec74f33ca0ea003437cd and splashd902ff7032e388365efbf09b523ae4ad899c606a are published through pixelelated; distribution pins follow the verified refs/archive checksum. The exact Tiny5 Duo LCD 2.007 source and OFL are retained; boot/ES/theme SVG bytes match. Identity0fail, focused cloud316PASS/0FAIL, proxy16 tests, C++ syntax, native splash rendering and package/vocabulary/pin checks pass. The full existing regression suite passed1,373 broad +316 focused checks,0FAIL, rc0. Watcher796756 recorded terminal success at02:17:32UTC; completion was reported in the active session. No job is running and no pixelelated image exists yet.

Six historical run101→/Rasteratops cases are retired and its re-interruption case now uses actual RC2, under the owner's explicit ROCKNIX-only requirement. New-layout interruption, marker, shelf and boundary controls remain. Retained first-run failures and negative control prevent confusing a scope correction with a product compatibility claim.

Source inventory: docs/pixelelated/rename-plan.md; prepared player docs: docs/pixelelated/cloud-folders.md; evidence: docs/qa-logs/2026-10-04-pixelelated-source/. #409 remains open through new-image qualification and P4. Its source/build portion precedes P4, not closure of this whole issue.

Distribution source/checkpoint commit: next a9af618398 (feature8d26722b91); plan61f3c27146 (feature092e4ae1c5).

## Interim wordmark system — owner refinement

> Here is a wordmark system we can use if you want to save this and then leverage this to create a new boot screen, a shutdown screen, or anything else we might need (animations, etc.).

> So we might need to modify this slightly because, as you said, it needs to be Tiny5 Duo LCD, not Tiny5 Duo.

The supplied specification sets RGB555 triplets as canonical, Ocean Bands as the default, six approved hard-band treatments, transparent LCD cell gaps, editable live text, outlined SVG distribution copies and two monochrome fallbacks. Save the full operative specification in docs/pixelelated/art/wordmark-system.md and preserve the LCD-specific face throughout. Derive hex equivalents from the supplied RGB555 rule where examples disagree.

At this asset-preparation stage the product still used monochrome. Ocean integration and its native renderer proof are now complete at the frozen pins above. Installed behavior remains a new-image criterion. Animation is a possible later use, with no sequence specified yet.

Can this be done on the VM? Yes — these vector assets can first be inspected and rasterized on the isolated host without any device or cloud access. Boot/shutdown behavior and final framebuffer sizes are then checked on the newly built GENERIC_X64 image. Host previews are asset proofs, not guest frames.

- [x] Saved specification and editable master explicitly name Tiny5 Duo LCD; recorded font hash matches the existing approved face.
- [x] Six outlined SVGs and two monochrome variants reproduce from the pinned font/palettes; exact RGB555 colors, alpha gaps, orientation and hard boundaries pass artifact checks.
- [x] Retained light/dark/midtone/saturated and small-size proofs demonstrate the portable assets; runtime integration remains separately tracked before the image freeze.

Wordmark asset proof: docs/pixelelated/art/proofs/artifact-checks.json records eight SVG variants and24 PNG exports with exact palette colors and binary alpha; all150 LCD contours match the earlier approved lettering after a canvas-only crop. Generator --check passes; a wrong font hash is rejected. Background and small-size proofs inspected. Runtime integration was subsequently completed at the frozen pins above; no new image exists.

Published asset/system commit: next bd3fcfa2281ebaf158f1b98790b12ee4455014b1 (feature8e990419075b51b648e074fefb0b8e5daf2f1d9f). Normal pushes and remote-ref readback succeeded. This historical asset-only commit preceded the now-completed Ocean integration and freeze above.
title: M7.P3: Transition the next RC to lowercase pixelelated
